description: This file contains unit tests for the ClaimDao class related to claim expenses within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It tests methods such as saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting claim expense records, ensuring proper functionality of the data access layer for claim expenses in the claim module.

classes.name: ClaimDaoExpenseTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ClaimDao's expense-related methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, setting up the ClaimDao instance and populating test data from a fixture.

methods.name: testSaveClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests saving a ClaimExpense object and verifies it receives the expected ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a ClaimExpense by its ID and verifies correctness.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of ClaimExpenses based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests deleting claim expenses and verifies the number of deleted records.
